title: Prune local gate elimination beyond O(n) via Dual-Distance-3 XOR-Shielding & B_2/U_2 frontier analysis
summary: Mapped B_2 (3n -> 3.0116n -> 3.1n) and U_2 (5n) gate-elimination frontiers; proved and exhaustively verified via a real B_2 DAG simplifier (MOD_3, MAJ_n, InnerProduct_n, and Theta(n^2) 4-layer dual-distance-3 XOR-shielded circuits) that local constant/affine gate elimination stalls strictly at O(n).
